CFP format page: '4 Automatic Bids: ACC, Big Ten, Big 12 & SEC Champions; 1 Automatic Bid: Highest-ranked team from the American, Conference USA, MAC, Mountain West, Pac-12 or Sun Belt; 7 At-Large Bids'; 'Notre Dame receives an automatic bid if it is ranked in the CFP Top 12 on Selection Day. If so, six (6) at-large bids would be awarded'; 'Seeds 1-4 receive first-round byes'; 'Any automatic qualifiers ranked outside the top 12 will be placed in order at the bottom of the seeding.' Same wording in the CFP's 24 Nov 2026 rankings release. NOTE wording: 'highest-ranked TEAM', not champion - Front Office Sports/The Athletic (Feb 2026) report the 2024 MOU gives the fifth bid to 'the highest ranked Group of 6 team overall, whether they are a conference champion or not', and G6 leaders considered asking to revert to champion; no change found. The same CFP page also says 'Five conference champions earn automatic bids' (internally inconsistent), and some outlets still write 'champion'. Field stays at 12 for 2026; a 24-team format was approved 9 Nov 2026 for 2027 (out of scope).
